```python
from z3 import *

# Declare variables relevant to the constraints
# (Only those appearing in the constraints are declared; booleans for C conditions,
#  Ints for functions returning int, and uninterpreted sorts for pointers/objects.)

# Boolean conditions from the C code
check = Bool('check')
check_named = Bool('check_named')
text = Bool('text')
list_curves = Bool('list_curves')
no_seed = Bool('no_seed')
point_format = Bool('point_format')

# Pointer / object nullity flags (encoded as Bool: True means non-NULL)
pctx_nonnull = Bool('pctx_nonnull')
params_key_nonnull = Bool('params_key_nonnull')
out_nonnull = Bool('out_nonnull')
curve_name_nonnull = Bool('curve_name_nonnull')
asn1_encoding_nonnull = Bool('asn1_encoding_nonnull')
gctx_params_nonnull = Bool('gctx_params_nonnull')

# Function return values (modeled as Int; <=0 means failure)
EVP_PKEY_param_check_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_param_check_ret')
EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret')
EVP_PKEY_print_params_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_print_params_ret')
EVP_PKEY_set_octet_string_param_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_set_octet_string_param_ret')
EVP_PKEY_keygen_init_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_keygen_init_ret')
EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params_ret')
EVP_PKEY_keygen_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_keygen_ret')

# Boolean results of helper functions
app_RAND_load_ret = Bool('app_RAND_load_ret')
opt_check_rest_arg_ret = Bool('opt_check_rest_arg_ret')
opt_provider_ret = Bool('opt_provider_ret')
opt_rand_ret = Bool('opt_rand_ret')
opt_string_asn1_ret = Bool('opt_string_asn1_ret')
opt_string_point_format_ret = Bool('opt_string_point_format_ret')
opt_format_out_ret = Bool('opt_format_out_ret')
opt_format_in_ret = Bool('opt_format_in_ret')

s = Solver()

# Constraint 1: !(check || check_named) || !(pctx == NULL || EVP_PKEY_param_check(pctx) <= 0)
# Included: relates to `check`, `check_named`, and `pctx` (via pctx_nonnull).
s.add(Or(Not(Or(check, check_named)),
         Not(Or(Not(pctx_nonnull), EVP_PKEY_param_check_ret <= 0))))

# Constraint 2: !(check || check_named) || !(check_named && !EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param(...))
# Included: relates to `check`, `check_named`, and params_key (via params_key_nonnull).
s.add(Or(Not(Or(check, check_named)),
         Not(And(check_named, EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret == 0))))

# Constraint 3: !(text && !EVP_PKEY_print_params(out, params_key, 0, NULL))
# Included: relates to `text`, `out`, and `params_key`.
s.add(Not(And(text, EVP_PKEY_print_params_ret == 0)))

# Constraint 4: !(list_curves)
# Included: relates to `list_curves`.
s.add(Not(list_curves))

# Constraint 5: !(out == NULL)
# Included: relates to `out`.
s.add(out_nonnull)

# Constraint 6: !(no_seed && !EVP_PKEY_set_octet_string_param(...))
# Included: relates to `no_seed` and `params_key`.
s.add(Not(And(no_seed, EVP_PKEY_set_octet_string_param_ret == 0)))

# Constraint 7: !(!(curve_name != NULL)) || !(asn1_encoding != NULL && !EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param(...))
# Included: relates to `curve_name` and `asn1_encoding`.
s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull),
         Not(And(asn1_encoding_nonnull, EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret == 0))))

# Constraint 8: !(!(curve_name != NULL)) || !(point_format && !EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param(...))
# Included: relates to `curve_name` and `point_format`.
s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull),
         Not(And(point_format, EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret == 0))))

# Constraint 9: !(!(curve_name != NULL)) || !(params_key == NULL)
# Included: relates to `curve_name` and `params_key`.
s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull), params_key_nonnull))

# Constraint 10: !(curve_name != NULL) || !(gctx_params == NULL || EVP_PKEY_keygen_init(...) <= 0 || EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params(...) <= 0 || EVP_PKEY_keygen(...) <= 0)
# Included: relates to `curve_name` and `gctx_params`.
s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull),
         Not(Or(Not(gctx_params_nonnull),
                EVP_PKEY_keygen_init_ret <= 0,
                EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params_ret <= 0,
                EVP_PKEY_keygen_ret <= 0))))

# Constraint 11: !(!app_RAND_load())
# Included: general precondition (no specific variable, but part of the constraint set).
s.add(app_RAND_load_ret)

# Constraint 12: !(!opt_check_rest_arg(NULL))
# Included: general precondition.
s.add(opt_check_rest_arg_ret)

# Constraint 13: !(!opt_provider(o))
# Included: general precondition.
s.add(opt_provider_ret)

# Constraint 14: !(!opt_rand(o))
# Included: general precondition.
s.add(opt_rand_ret)

# Constraint 15: !(!opt_string(asn1_encoding, asn1_encoding_options))
# Included: relates to `asn1_encoding`.
s.add(opt_string_asn1_ret)

# Constraint 16: !(!opt_string(point_format, point_format_options))
# Included: relates to `point_format`.
s.add(opt_string_point_format_ret)

# Constraint 17: !(!opt_format(opt_arg(), OPT_FMT_PEMDER, &outformat))
# Included: general precondition.
s.add(opt_format_out_ret)

# Constraint 18: !(!opt_format(opt_arg(), OPT_FMT_PEMDER, &informat))
# Included: general precondition.
s.add(opt_format_in_ret)

# Check satisfiability and print result
print(s.check())
```
